name: Vera de Moncayo (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white triangle from the hoist to the centre of the fly, charged at the hoist with a vine leaf, a letter and a crozier.
history: Municipal flag of Vera de Moncayo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the fly
vine leaf edged red on the triangle
letter V above and crozier below the leaf
